name: Exact Product Criterion for Cube-Chordal Ample Classes
statement: For nonempty ample H,K on disjoint coordinates, H times K is cube-chordal iff both factors are cube-chordal and at least one is a daisy cube.
proof: The maximal-cube graph of a product is the strong product of the factor graphs. Both connected factors must be chordal; if neither is complete, induced three-vertex paths supply an induced four-cycle in the strong product. A complete factor instead replaces each vertex by a clique and preserves chordality. A complete maximal-cube graph is equivalent to a daisy orientation.
